title: Demo: What's Included in Cruise Fare (Synthetic FAQ)
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMO CONTENT — not real operator policy.
content: In this demo, the cruise fare typically includes your stateroom accommodation, most onboard meals in the main dining venues, select non-alcoholic beverages, daily entertainment, and access to pools and fitness areas. Specialty dining, alcoholic beverages, spa services, shore excursions, and Wi‑Fi packages are not included unless explicitly bundled in a promotional demo package. Gratuities may be added separately at checkout in the existing checkout boundary. Prices and availability are always determined by deterministic commerce services, never by AI narration.
